question: Does a pause-verdict confidence gate (silence below threshold instead of corrective actions) repair the good-frame overcorrections, and does any threshold improve the lane?
claim_scope: Simulator still-image replay over AI-first-pass labels on a dirty working tree. Gate simulation over the committed technical-override lane rows through the canonical scorer; no source change, no release measurement.

method.gate_rule: clear semantic_actions on the pause row when the pause row confidence < t; merge and score; live rows untouched
method.reproduction_check: ungated merge scores pass_rate=0.534483 / preservation=0.839506 / expected_hit=0.689655, matching the committed lane

separation.finding: Pause confidence does not separate overcorrected good frames from correctly-kept good frames.
separation.mechanism_note: Mixed verdicts with corrections are capped at 0.74 by pauseVerdictConfidence and dominant-issue good verdicts are floored at 0.75, so the gate's low-confidence region contains almost no corrected good frames while it does contain kept good frames down to 0.463.

decision.arithmetic: No threshold raises pass_rate: the best passing count under the gate is 92/174 (t<=0.58) against the ungated 93/174, and at t=0.69-0.70, where preservation improves to 0.864198 and forbidden violations drop to 22, pass_rate falls to 91/174 (0.522989) because missing_expected_action grows faster (+3) than the overcorrection (-2) and forbidden (-2) repairs. At t=0.75 preservation reaches 0.925926 but pass_rate collapses to 81/174 (0.465517). No threshold approaches the release forbidden gate of <= 0.02: the best reachable forbidden rate is 0.091954 at t=0.75 with the lane destroyed.
decision.reading: The gate is a monotone trade that buys preservation with expected-action hits, and the confidence signal is compressed into the wrong region by the existing verdict-confidence caps. Rejected at every threshold; recorded as a known limitation of pause confidence as an uncertainty signal.

consequence: With this, the pause-confidence lever joins the exhausted set (clutter thresholds, occlusion routing, distractor/subject-size signals, confidence-parity restoration, isolation-rule relaxation). The remaining open work on this lane is owner-gated or requires new labeled data.
